card.name: Rocket
card.subject: A tall upright rocket: a white cylinder body with a pointed red nose cone, one round porthole window, and three symmetrical fins at the base, standing on a flat concrete launch pad.
card.hero_colors: white body, red nose cone and fins, small blue porthole

card.name: Flying Saucer
card.subject: A perfectly round, symmetrical flying saucer: a wide silver disc with a glass dome on top and a ring of eight round lights around the rim.
card.hero_colors: silver disc, light blue dome, small orange rim lights

card.name: Ringed Planet
card.subject: A perfectly round planet with one wide flat ring circling its middle, tilted slightly.
card.hero_colors: orange planet, pale yellow ring, a small band of red stripe on the planet

card.name: Space Helmet
card.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a big round gold visor at the front and a thick neck ring at the bottom.
card.hero_colors: white shell, gold visor, small blue neck ring

card.name: Comet
card.subject: A comet: a round icy rock head with a long curved glowing tail trailing behind it.
card.hero_colors: icy white-blue head, pale blue tail, small orange glow at the head

card.name: Control Panel
card.subject: A boxy control console with a sloped top, a row of six round buttons, two round dials, and one wide flat screen.
card.hero_colors: grey metal body, dark screen, small red buttons

card.name: Teleport Pod
card.subject: A teleport pod: an upright glass cylinder with a round metal base and a round metal cap, standing on a metal floor.
card.hero_colors: clear glass, silver base and cap, small cyan glow ring on the base

card.name: Moon Rover
card.subject: A small moon rover: a boxy white body on six round wheels with a round dish fixed on top, driving on grey moon dust with craters.
card.hero_colors: white body, black wheels, small yellow dish

card.name: Moon Base
card.subject: A moon base: a round white dome with a small round door, joined to a short tube-shaped tunnel on its side, resting on the ground.
card.hero_colors: white dome, grey tunnel, small orange door

card.name: Zero Gravity
card.subject: The man in a round glass space helmet clings to a seat while the pig floats upward beside him with her curly tail spinning.
card.hero_colors: white space suits, brown mustache, pink pig
card.surface_or_setting: inside a bright spaceship cabin with a round window
